concept: CloudFront OAC: private S3 origin reachable only via CloudFront
tests: Restricting access to an S3 bucket so objects are accessible only through CloudFront.
expected: Origin Access Control (OAC) + a bucket policy granting s3:GetObject only to the distribution (AWS:SourceArn). Triggers: "bucket is not public", "access only through CloudFront".
why_not: A public bucket violates the requirement (geo-restriction only filters countries); Transfer Acceleration does not restrict access; an ALB does not front S3 this way.
